data.hook: Shannon Sharpe's tweet poked fun at Cowboys fans for supposedly thinking backup Cooper Rush matched Dak Prescott. Fans fired back hard, blaming media hype from 2022.
data.name: Cowboys Fans Reject Sharpe's Claim on Cooper Rush Hype
data.summary: Hall of Famer Shannon Sharpe posted that Cowboys fans once believed Cooper Rush was as good as Dak Prescott, drawing quick denials from supporters who pointed to media narratives during Rush's three-win streak that year while Prescott recovered from injury. Rush, now with the Falcons, started their Week 1 loss to the Steelers with a middling performance of 143 yards, one touchdown, and two picks. Fans insisted the push to keep Rush starting came from analysts like Keyshawn Johnson, not their own views, showing their strong loyalty to Prescott remains firm.

data.name: Odell Beckham Jr. Rocks Blonde Hair and One-Hander in Giants Return
data.summary: Beckham, now 33, signed a one-year deal and earned his roster spot after a strong preseason, marking his first Giants regular-season game since December 2018. He wore a "NEVER FORGET" shirt with a pink ribbon and obliged young teammates' requests to revive his signature blonde look. The eye-catching warmup catch from Jaxson Dart thrilled fans ahead of the primetime NFC East matchup against the Cowboys, with star receiver Malik Nabers active despite his recent ACL tear. While some recalled past games, most savored the throwback energy as Beckham reclaimed his No. 13 jersey.

data.name: Falcons Fans Chant for Rookie QB Jack Strand After Loss to Steelers
data.summary: Atlanta fell 20-13 to Pittsburgh in Week 1, with emergency starter Cooper Rush going 12-of-22 for 143 yards, one touchdown, and two picks. Frustrated supporters flooded online posts calling to bench Rush for undrafted rookie Jack Strand, the 6-foot-5 backup from Minnesota State Moorhead who impressed in preseason. One fan wrote, 'Give us Jack Strand or give us death,' while others questioned why the promising 22-year-old didn't start amid injuries to Tua Tagovailoa and Michael Penix Jr. The push highlighted fans' quick disappointment after turnovers and a defense that couldn't hold the lead.

data.hook: Odell Beckham Jr. unveiled his signature platinum blonde hair just in time for his emotional return to the New York Giants, nodding to the young teammates who requested it.
data.name: Odell Beckham Jr. Revives Blonde Hair for Giants-Cowboys Reunion
data.summary: The 33-year-old wide receiver, back with the Giants on a one-year deal after stints elsewhere, dyed his hair ahead of Sunday Night Football against the Dallas Cowboys at MetLife Stadium. It recalls his breakout 2014 one-handed catch on the same stage, a moment that launched his stardom. Beckham called it a fun switch-up and core memory for the team, while speaking warmly about giving his all to the fans and organization that started his career. The game kicks off at 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC and Peacock.
